# Fork Conversation: the coding agent's conversation in a pane, carried on
# in a new pane beside it (or a tab) by the agent's own fork. Run with
# `command = cat` (so the forks' command lines are only shown, never run)
# and --persist (a pane's conversation goes by its session).
conversation:claude:abc123
action:fork_conversation
wait:6.5
expect-panes:2
expect:claude --resume abc123 --fork-session
# Codex's, into a tab.
conversation:codex:019a77
action:fork_conversation:tab
wait:6.5
expect-tab-count:2
expect:codex fork 019a77
# A pane whose conversation Libertty doesn't know says why it can't.
action:fork_conversation
expect-sheet:yes
expect-sheet-text:Can't fork the conversation
sheet:OK
expect-sheet:no
expect-tab-count:2
